Statistical Analysis</h3><div class=\"html-p\">Descriptive statistics included the arithmetic mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation, median, interquartile range, and range. For the mean and median, 95% confidence intervals were estimated using the percentile bootstrap method with 5000 replications and a fixed seed for the pseudorandom number generator.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Each benchmark scenario was analyzed separately.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The effects of model family, precision format, and their interaction were assessed using a two-factor linear model (3):<div class=\"html-disp-formula-info\" id=\"FD3-energies-19-04893\">\n      <div class=\"f\">\n        <span class=\"html-italic\">Y</span><sub>{</sub><span class=\"html-italic\"><sub>ijk</sub></span><sub>}</sub> = <span class=\"html-italic\">μ</span> + <span class=\"html-italic\">α<sub>i</sub></span> + <span class=\"html-italic\">β<sub>j</sub></span> + (<span class=\"html-italic\">αβ</span>)<sub>{</sub><span class=\"html-italic\"><sub>ij</sub></span><sub>}</sub> + <span class=\"html-italic\">ε</span><sub>{</sub><span class=\"html-italic\"><sub>ijk</sub></span><sub>}</sub>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"l\">\n      <label>(3)</label>\n      </div>\n    </div> where</div><div class=\"html-p\"><span class=\"html-italic\">Y<sub>ijk</sub></span>—value of the analyzed dependent variable;</div><div class=\"html-p\"><span class=\"html-italic\">μ</span>—overall mean;</div><div class=\"html-p\"><span class=\"html-italic\">α<sub>i</sub></span>—effect of the <span class=\"html-italic\">i</span>-th model family;</div><div class=\"html-p\"><span class=\"html-italic\">β<sub>j</sub></span>—effect of the <span class=\"html-italic\">j</span>-th precision format;</div><div class=\"html-p\">(<span class=\"html-italic\">αβ</span>)<span class=\"html-italic\"><sub>ij</sub></span>—model family × precision format interaction;</div><div class=\"html-p\"><span class=\"html-italic\">ε<sub>ijk</sub></span>—residual error.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The factors were coded using sum-to-zero contrasts, and their effects were assessed using Type III analysis of variance. Positive energy and time variables, as well as the corresponding positive-valued performance variables included in the statistical models, were transformed using the natural logarithm.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Because heteroscedasticity was present, standard errors and test statistics were calculated using the heteroscedasticity-consistent HC3 covariance estimator. Effect sizes for the factorial analyses were reported as partial eta squared <math display=\"inline\"><semantics>\n  <mrow>\n    <msubsup>\n      <mi>η</mi>\n      <mi>p</mi>\n      <mn>2</mn>\n    </msubsup>\n  </mrow>\n</semantics></math>.</div><div class=\"html-p\">For the predefined primary endpoints, the family-wise probability of a Type I error was controlled using the Holm procedure. For exploratory results of the factorial models, the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure was applied to control the false discovery rate. All statistical tests were two-sided.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Planned pairwise comparisons included comparisons between precision formats within each model family and comparisons between model families within a given precision format.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Parametric comparisons were performed using Welch’s <span class=\"html-italic\">t</span>-test. The reported measures included differences in means with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals, ratios of means, and Hedges’ effect sizes.</div><div class=\"html-p\">As a sensitivity analysis, corresponding comparisons were additionally evaluated using the Mann–Whitney test and Cliff’s delta.</div><div class=\"html-p\">For the planned pairwise analyses, <span class=\"html-italic\">p</span>-values were adjusted using the Holm procedure separately within scientifically interpretable contrast families defined by benchmark scenario, endpoint, comparison type, and model or precision stratum.</div></section><section id=\"sec2dot5-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  2.5. Multi-Criteria Hardware-Efficiency Analysis</h3><div class=\"html-p\">For the three generation scenarios, hardware efficiency was additionally evaluated using the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS).</div><div class=\"html-p\">Four criteria were included:</div><div class=\"html-p\"><ul class=\"html-bullet\"><li><div class=\"html-p\">Dynamic energy per processed token—lower values were preferred;</div></li><li><div class=\"html-p\">Generation throughput—higher values were preferred;</div></li><li><div class=\"html-p\">Maximum GPU memory utilization—lower values were preferred;</div></li><li><div class=\"html-p\">Mean GPU power—lower values were preferred.</div></li></ul></div><div class=\"html-p\">The respective TOPSIS weights were 0.55 for dynamic energy per processed token, 0.25 for generation throughput, 0.10 for maximum GPU memory utilization, and 0.10 for mean GPU power. The weights were defined a priori to represent the energy-oriented evaluation objective of the study; they were not estimated from the observed performance of the evaluated configurations and should not be interpreted as universally optimal TOPSIS weights. The weighting scheme was designed to reflect the energy-oriented hardware-efficiency perspective of the study. Dynamic energy per processed token was assigned the highest weight (0.55) because it directly quantifies the energy required to process a unit of model output and therefore represents the primary efficiency outcome considered in this work. Generation throughput was assigned the second-highest weight (0.25), ensuring that energy efficiency was evaluated jointly with inference performance. Together, these two criteria accounted for 80% of the TOPSIS weighting and represented the primary operational-efficiency dimension.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Maximum GPU memory utilization and mean GPU power were assigned lower and equal weights (0.10 each), as they were considered complementary hardware-resource criteria rather than primary measures of inference efficiency. In particular, mean GPU power is not independent of energy consumption, since energy corresponds to power integrated over execution time. Assigning a comparatively low weight to mean power therefore also reduces the risk of disproportionately emphasizing related energy characteristics in the composite score.</div><div class=\"html-p\">To complement the weight-dependent TOPSIS ranking, Pareto non-dominated configurations were identified independently of the TOPSIS scores. A configuration was considered Pareto non-dominated when no alternative configuration performed at least as well on all included criteria while performing strictly better on at least one criterion.</div><div class=\"html-p\">TOPSIS rankings were interpreted exclusively as comparisons of hardware-resource efficiency under the adopted criteria and weighting scheme. Because the study did not independently evaluate response quality, task accuracy, factuality, reasoning ability, or other measures of model utility, the resulting rankings were not interpreted as rankings of the overall quality of the language models.</div></section></section></div><div id=\"Results\" data-heading-anchor=\"1\"><section id=\"sec3-energies-19-04893\" type=\"results\"><h2 data-nested=\"1\">  3. Results</h2><div class=\"html-p\">In PP-512, under the employed measurement protocol, the factorial analysis did not detect statistically significant effects of model family, precision format, or their interaction on total request energy, prompt-processing throughput, or execution time after false discovery rate (FDR) correction. Given the short request duration relative to the 50 ms telemetry interval, however, the PP-512 energy comparison is considered measurement-constrained and inconclusive with respect to small between-configuration differences. The absence of statistical significance should therefore not be interpreted as evidence of equivalent energy consumption among the evaluated configurations.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The precision effect for total energy was close to the adopted significance threshold (<math display=\"inline\"><semantics>\n  <mrow>\n    <mrow>\n      <mi>F</mi>\n      <mo>=</mo>\n      <mn>3.16</mn>\n      <mo>,</mo>\n      <mo> </mo>\n      <msub>\n        <mi>p</mi>\n        <mi mathvariant=\"italic\">FDR</mi>\n      </msub>\n      <mo>=</mo>\n      <mn>0.054</mn>\n      <mo>,</mo>\n      <mo> </mo>\n      <msubsup>\n        <mi>η</mi>\n        <mi>p</mi>\n        <mn>2</mn>\n      </msubsup>\n      <mo>=</mo>\n      <mn>0.121</mn>\n    </mrow>\n  </mrow>\n</semantics></math>).</div><div class=\"html-p\">The Gemma 4 E4B IT–Q4_K_M configuration achieved the lowest average total energy in PP-512. The next-best result was achieved by the Ministral 3 3B Instruct–Q4_K_M. Given the absence of statistically significant effects in the factorial model and the overlapping confidence intervals, these numerical differences were not interpreted as evidence of superiority of one configuration over another.</div><div class=\"html-p\">In PP-1024, an effect of precision on total Energy (<span class=\"html-italic\">F</span> = 5.96, <span class=\"html-italic\">p<sub>FDR</sub></span> = 0.0024, <math display=\"inline\"><semantics>\n  <mrow>\n    <mrow>\n      <msubsup>\n        <mi>η</mi>\n        <mi>p</mi>\n        <mn>2</mn>\n      </msubsup>\n      <mo>=</mo>\n      <mn>0.203</mn>\n      <mo>)</mo>\n    </mrow>\n  </mrow>\n</semantics></math> and on average GPU power (<span class=\"html-italic\">F</span> = 5.01, <span class=\"html-italic\">p<sub>FDR</sub></span> = 0.0063, <math display=\"inline\"><semantics>\n  <mrow>\n    <mrow>\n      <msubsup>\n        <mi>η</mi>\n        <mi>p</mi>\n        <mn>2</mn>\n      </msubsup>\n      <mo>=</mo>\n      <mn>0.1790</mn>\n    </mrow>\n  </mrow>\n</semantics></math>) was observed. No significant model family effects or interactions were found for these variables. No significant effects were found for prompt processing throughput or execution time either.</div><div class=\"html-p\">In terms of total energy, the Ministral 3 3B Instruct–Q4_K_M achieved the lowest value in PP-1024. This configuration also achieved the highest average prompt throughput, at 3493.7 tokens/s, 95% CI [2804.6; 4182.9]. However, the differences in throughput between models and precision formats were not statistically significant in the factor model. The results discussed are presented in <a href=\"#energies-19-04893-t001\" class=\"html-table\">Table 1</a>.</div><div class=\"html-table-wrap\" id=\"energies-19-04893-t001\" data-position=\"float\"><button type=\"button\" class=\"html-media-expand\" aria-hidden=\"true\" tabindex=\"-1\"><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\"><path fill=\"currentColor\" d=\"M3 21v-8h2v4.6L17.6 5H13V3h8v8h-2V6.4L6.4 19H11v2z\"></path></svg></button>\n  <div class=\"html-table_wrap_td\">\n    <div class=\"html-tablepopup html-tablepopup-link\" href=\"#table_body_display_energies-19-04893-t001\">\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"html-media-button\" aria-label=\"View table 1\"><img src=\"https://pub.mdpi-res.com/img/table.png\" alt=\"\" role=\"presentation\" loading=\"lazy\" decoding=\"async\" width=\"225\" height=\"135\"></button>\n       \n    </div>\n\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"html-table_wrap_discription\">\n    <b>Table 1.</b>\n    Mean total request energy and mean prompt-processing throughput in prefill-only scenarios. Values are arithmetic means [95% bootstrap confidence intervals], based on 10 repetitions per model–precision–scenario configuration.\n  </div>\n</div><div class=\"html-p\">In terms of energy and throughput, the Q4_K_M configurations—particularly the Ministral 3 3B Instruct–Q4_K_M and the Nemotron 3 Nano 4B–Q4_K_M—stood out from the other configurations in all three generation scenarios. Ministral–Q4_K_M combined the lowest dynamic energy per token with the highest throughput, while Nemotron–Q4_K_M used less GPU memory. The Relationship Between Dynamic Energy and Throughput, and the Pareto Fronts in TG-256, PG-512/256, and PG-2048/256 are shown in <a href=\"#energies-19-04893-f001\" class=\"html-fig\">Figure 1</a>. This figure shows a two-dimensional projection of the Pareto set obtained using all four criteria. Non-dominated configurations were identified separately for each workload scenario based on four criteria: dynamic energy consumption per processed token (minimized), generation throughput (maximized), peak GPU memory usage (minimized), and average GPU power consumption (minimized). Discussion</h2><section id=\"sec4dot1-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  4.1. Principal Findings</h3><div class=\"html-p\">The results demonstrate that the relationship between weight precision and GPU energy efficiency is strongly dependent on workload phase and model architecture. The clearest pattern was observed during autoregressive generation. Across all three generation scenarios, model family, precision format, and their interaction significantly affected the primary endpoints, with very large effect sizes for both model family and precision. The significant interaction is particularly important because it indicates that the benefit associated with a given weight representation cannot be interpreted independently of the model on which it is applied.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Within all four tested model families, Q4_K_M was substantially more energy-efficient and faster than BF16 during generation. Depending on the model and scenario, Q4_K_M reduced mean dynamic energy per processed token by 63.6–85.7% and increased generation throughput by 85.2–160.2%. These improvements were statistically robust across the planned Q4_K_M–BF16 comparisons. The magnitude of the effect therefore indicates that, in the tested environment, aggressive weight quantization was not merely a memory-saving mechanism; it translated into substantial reductions in GPU energy required for token generation.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The results were less uniform in the prefill-only workloads. No statistically supported effects of model family, precision, or their interaction were detected for total request energy, prompt throughput, or execution time in PP-512. In PP-1024, precision affected total energy and average GPU power, but corresponding effects on prompt throughput and execution time were not significant. These findings should not be interpreted as evidence that the configurations are equivalent during prefill. Rather, they indicate that statistically supported differences were limited under the adopted workload and measurement design.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Consequently, the answer to the question posed in the article title is conditional. Lower precision produced very large and consistent benefits when Q4_K_M was compared with BF16 during the tested generation workloads, but the same strength of evidence was not observed for short prefill-only requests. Nominal precision therefore cannot be treated as a universal predictor of request-level GPU energy across all inference phases.</div></section><section id=\"sec4dot2-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  4.2. Why the Effect of Quantization Depends on the Workload Phase</h3><div class=\"html-p\">The difference between prefill and generation is consistent with established characterizations of LLM inference. Prompt processing and autoregressive decoding have different computational profiles: prefill is relatively compute-intensive, whereas token generation is more strongly influenced by repeated weight access and memory traffic [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 6\" reference-link=\"#B6-energies-19-04893\">6</span>]. Weight quantization directly reduces the amount of model data that must be stored and transferred and can therefore be particularly advantageous in workloads where memory movement limits performance. AWQ similarly identifies memory size and memory bandwidth as key constraints in LLM serving and demonstrates substantial generation speedups from hardware-oriented weight-only quantization [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 10\" reference-link=\"#B10-energies-19-04893\">10</span>].</div><div class=\"html-p\">This provides a plausible mechanism for the strong Q4_K_M advantage observed during generation. A smaller weight representation may reduce memory traffic sufficiently to increase token throughput, shorten execution time, and thereby lower energy per token even if the instantaneous GPU power does not decrease proportionally. Importantly, the present experiment did not directly decompose energy into arithmetic, memory-transfer, cache, or dequantization components. The mechanism should therefore be interpreted as being consistent with previous system-level findings rather than as a directly measured causal decomposition.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The prefill results require additional caution because the requests were short relative to the nominal 50 ms NVML sampling interval. The study appropriately refrained from interpreting dynamically baseline-corrected energy for these cases. This measurement constraint reduces the ability to distinguish small differences between configurations during short prompt-processing workloads. Therefore, the absence of statistically significant differences in PP-512 should not be interpreted as proof that quantization has no influence on prefill energy.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The results also demonstrate why power and energy should not be used interchangeably. A configuration may have higher or similar mean power while still consuming less energy if it finishes the request substantially faster. Conversely, reducing mean GPU power alone does not guarantee improved energy efficiency. For deployment decisions, energy per completed request or per token should therefore be considered together with throughput and latency.</div></section><section id=\"sec4dot3-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  4.3. Model Family and Quantization Format Interact</h3><div class=\"html-p\">The very large main effects of precision were accompanied by substantial model × precision interactions. This result reinforces the conclusion that quantization should be evaluated as a property of a complete model–runtime–hardware configuration rather than as an isolated numerical parameter. GPTQ, LLM.int8(), SmoothQuant, and AWQ already demonstrate that quantization performance depends strongly on how weights, activations, scaling factors, and outliers are represented and processed [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 7\" reference-link=\"#B7-energies-19-04893\">7</span>,<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 8\" reference-link=\"#B8-energies-19-04893\">8</span>,<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 9\" reference-link=\"#B9-energies-19-04893\">9</span>,<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 10\" reference-link=\"#B10-energies-19-04893\">10</span>]. Recent low-precision research similarly emphasizes that the detailed numerical representation and hardware execution strategy can matter as much as nominal bit width itself [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 11\" reference-link=\"#B11-energies-19-04893\">11</span>].</div><div class=\"html-p\">The present results extend this observation to GPU energy consumption. Although Q4_K_M outperformed BF16 within every tested model family during generation, the magnitude of the reduction differed substantially among models. For Ministral 3 3B Instruct, Q4_K_M reduced dynamic energy per token by 84.0–85.7% relative to BF16 while increasing throughput by 105.2–160.2%. This was one of the strongest effects observed in the benchmark.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The cross-model comparison between the two strongest Q4_K_M configurations further illustrates the architectural component. Ministral–Q4_K_M used 37.1–42.6% less dynamic energy per token than Nemotron–Q4_K_M across the three generation scenarios and achieved approximately 10.9–12.1% higher mean throughput. At the same time, Nemotron required substantially less GPU memory. Thus, even after the same nominal quantization format was selected, the two model families occupied different positions in the energy–performance–memory design space.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Cross-model comparisons must nevertheless be interpreted as comparisons of complete systems. The models differ in architecture, parameterization, tokenizer behavior, and potentially other implementation characteristics. They should therefore not be interpreted as a controlled estimate of the causal effect of model architecture alone. The strongest evidence regarding precision comes from within-family comparisons, where the underlying model is held constant.</div></section><section id=\"sec4dot4-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  4.4. Multi-Criteria Efficiency: TOPSIS and Pareto Analysis</h3><div class=\"html-p\">Considering a single metric would obscure several practically important trade-offs. Ministral 3 3B Instruct–Q4_K_M achieved the lowest dynamic energy per token and the highest generation throughput among the leading configurations and consequently ranked first in TOPSIS in all three generation scenarios, with scores of 0.981–0.982. Nemotron 3 Nano 4B–Q4_K_M ranked second in each scenario, with scores of 0.917–0.932. These two configurations were also the only solutions located on the Pareto frontier in all three generation scenarios.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The Pareto result is particularly useful because it does not require assigning explicit weights to optimization criteria. Neither configuration completely dominated the other: Ministral offered superior energy efficiency and throughput, whereas Nemotron required approximately 4.9 GiB of GPU memory compared with approximately 6.4 GiB for Ministral. The appropriate configuration therefore depends on the deployment constraint.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Under the adopted TOPSIS weights, dynamic energy per token and throughput accounted jointly for 80% of the decision weight. Consequently, the lower energy requirement and higher throughput of Ministral outweighed its approximately 30% larger GPU-memory footprint. If memory capacity were the dominant operational constraint, however, Nemotron would represent the more favorable option.</div><div class=\"html-p\">This finding illustrates an important deployment principle: the most energy-efficient configuration is not necessarily the optimal configuration for every system. GPU memory may determine whether several model instances can be hosted simultaneously, while throughput may determine service capacity and energy may dominate operating costs. Multi-criteria analysis therefore complements single-metric benchmarking, but its results must always be interpreted in relation to the selected criteria and weights.</div></section><section id=\"sec4dot5-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  4.5. Relation to Previous Research</h3><div class=\"html-p\">The substantial performance improvements associated with low-precision weights are consistent with earlier quantization research. GPTQ showed that 3- and 4-bit post-training weight quantization can substantially reduce LLM storage and enable faster inference while retaining useful accuracy [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 7\" reference-link=\"#B7-energies-19-04893\">7</span>]. LLM.int8() demonstrated the value of mixed-precision treatment of outliers [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 8\" reference-link=\"#B8-energies-19-04893\">8</span>], while SmoothQuant and AWQ reported substantial memory and performance benefits from hardware-oriented quantization strategies [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 9\" reference-link=\"#B9-energies-19-04893\">9</span>,<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 10\" reference-link=\"#B10-energies-19-04893\">10</span>]. BlockDialect further demonstrates continuing interest in explicitly energy-efficient low-precision inference [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 11\" reference-link=\"#B11-energies-19-04893\">11</span>].</div><div class=\"html-p\">The present study differs from much of this literature by focusing directly on measured GPU energy rather than treating memory reduction or inference speed as proxies for energy efficiency. This distinction is important because faster inference does not mathematically guarantee lower energy consumption unless the accompanying power profile is also considered.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The present findings are also consistent with recent empirical studies showing that LLM inference energy is strongly dependent on workload and deployment conditions. Fernandez et al. demonstrated that the energy impact of inference optimizations varies substantially across workload geometries, software stacks, and GPU platforms [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 15\" reference-link=\"#B15-energies-19-04893\">15</span>], while the ML.ENERGY Benchmark showed large differences in inference energy among model, task, and deployment configurations [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 16\" reference-link=\"#B16-energies-19-04893\">16</span>]. Similarly, Oviedo et al. reported a strong dependence of per-query energy on token generation requirements and serving assumptions [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 17\" reference-link=\"#B17-energies-19-04893\">17</span>]. The present results extend this body of evidence by demonstrating that, even when the GPU platform and inference backend are held constant, weight representation format interacts strongly with model family and workload phase.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The findings also complement recent work published in <span class=\"html-italic\">Energies</span>. Kaur et al. emphasized the importance of workload-specific assessment when estimating the operational energy and emissions associated with LLM inference [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 12\" reference-link=\"#B12-energies-19-04893\">12</span>], whereas Kang and Park demonstrated that accelerator-level energy efficiency depends on the characteristics of the execution platform [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 13\" reference-link=\"#B13-energies-19-04893\">13</span>]. The present study contributes a more narrowly controlled perspective by examining the energy–performance consequences of weight representation under a fixed single-GPU environment. This design does not replace broader system-level benchmarking, but allows the contribution of quantization format to be evaluated with fewer hardware-related confounders.</div><div class=\"html-p\">The findings also align with the broader Green AI principle that computational efficiency should be measured explicitly rather than inferred from model size or theoretical operation counts [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 1\" reference-link=\"#B1-energies-19-04893\">1</span>,<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 2\" reference-link=\"#B2-energies-19-04893\">2</span>]. The marked differences observed between prefill and generation are consistent with recent calls for phase-aware inference benchmarking and for the joint reporting of request-level and token-normalized energy metrics [<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 5\" reference-link=\"#B5-energies-19-04893\">5</span>,<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 15\" reference-link=\"#B15-energies-19-04893\">15</span>,<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 16\" reference-link=\"#B16-energies-19-04893\">16</span>,<span tabindex=\"0\" role=\"link\" class=\"html-reference\" aria-label=\"Reference 17\" reference-link=\"#B17-energies-19-04893\">17</span>].</div><div class=\"html-p\">At the same time, the present results do not establish the environmental footprint of the tested models in a full life-cycle sense. The measurements concern operational GPU energy only. They do not include embodied hardware impacts, data-center cooling, power-delivery overhead, CPU and system energy, or the carbon intensity of the electricity supply. Consequently, the results should be described as GPU energy-efficiency findings rather than direct estimates of carbon emissions or comprehensive environmental sustainability.</div></section><section id=\"sec4dot6-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  4.6. Interpretation of Token-Normalized Energy</h3><div class=\"html-p\">An additional methodological point concerns comparisons of dynamic energy per processed token between workload scenarios. In TG-256, nearly all processed tokens belong to the autoregressive generation phase, whereas the PG-512/256 and PG-2048/256 scenarios contain progressively larger proportions of prompt tokens. Because prompt processing and token generation have different computational characteristics, the denominator in the J/token metric represents a different mixture of work in each scenario.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Accordingly, the decrease in absolute J/token values observed when moving from TG-256 to workloads containing longer prompts should not be interpreted simply as evidence that longer prompts intrinsically improve energy efficiency. Token-normalized energy is most directly comparable between configurations evaluated within the same scenario. Request-level energy, energy per output token, throughput, and workload composition should be considered alongside J/token when comparisons are made across scenarios.</div><div class=\"html-p\">This distinction is particularly relevant in LLM energy benchmarking because normalization can strongly affect conclusions. A metric that is appropriate for comparing two implementations under the same workload may become misleading when prompt length, generated-token count, or batching structure changes substantially.</div></section><section id=\"sec4dot7-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  4.7. Practical Implications</h3><div class=\"html-p\">Several practical implications follow from the results. First, weight quantization should be benchmarked on the intended model–GPU–runtime combination rather than selected solely based on nominal precision. The substantial model × precision interaction indicates that the magnitude of the energy benefit is architecture-dependent.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Second, optimization should be workload-aware. Systems dominated by autoregressive generation may obtain very large benefits from low-bit weight representations, whereas the gains for short prefill workloads may be smaller or more difficult to measure reliably. Applications with different prompt-to-output ratios may therefore favor different deployment configurations.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Third, throughput and energy should be evaluated jointly. In the present benchmark, the most energy-efficient generation configurations were also among the fastest, indicating that higher throughput and lower energy per token need not represent conflicting objectives. Nevertheless, GPU memory introduces an additional constraint that can change the preferred deployment choice.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Finally, energy benchmarking should report sufficient context to make results reproducible: the specific model artifact, quantization format, inference backend, hardware platform, software version, workload composition, energy-measurement method, and normalization denominator are all relevant to interpretation. Energy values should not be generalized across hardware or inference engines without validation.</div></section><section id=\"sec4dot8-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h3 class=\"html-italic\" data-nested=\"2\">  4.8. Limitations and Future Work</h3><div class=\"html-p\">The study has several limitations. First, all experiments were conducted on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090. The results therefore characterize the tested consumer-GPU environment and should not be generalized directly to other NVIDIA architectures, data-center accelerators, or non-NVIDIA hardware. Different GPUs provide different low-precision arithmetic capabilities, memory bandwidth, cache hierarchies, and power-management behavior.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Second, inference was performed using llama.cpp with a CUDA backend in a Windows environment. Quantization performance is sensitive to kernel implementation and runtime optimization; consequently, the numerical results may differ under alternative frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or other CUDA/Linux serving stacks.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Third, the energy measurements represent GPU energy derived from NVML telemetry rather than whole-system electricity consumption. CPU activity, host memory, storage, power-supply losses, and cooling overhead were outside the measurement boundary. The results should therefore be interpreted specifically as GPU-level operational energy.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Fourth, the 50 ms nominal telemetry interval limits the temporal resolution available for very short requests. This is particularly relevant to the prefill-only scenarios and is one reason why dynamic baseline-corrected energy was not interpreted for those workloads.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Fifth, one request was executed per iteration. The benchmark therefore does not reproduce production environments involving continuous batching, concurrent users, request scheduling, or high GPU utilization. Such operating modes may alter both throughput and energy efficiency.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Sixth, the evaluated prompts extended to 2048 input tokens. Long-context inference may exhibit different relationships among attention computation, KV-cache activity, memory traffic, and quantization. Future work should therefore include longer contexts and varying input/output ratios.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Seventh, response quality was not measured. The TOPSIS and Pareto analyses consequently evaluate hardware-resource efficiency rather than overall model utility. A configuration that minimizes energy per token may be less attractive if quantization materially reduces task accuracy, reasoning performance, factuality, or other quality dimensions. Future work should combine energy measurements with within-model quality-retention metrics and construct quality–energy Pareto frontiers.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Eighth, TOPSIS rankings depend on the selected weights. Although Pareto analysis provides a weight-independent complement, future work should include a sensitivity analysis to determine whether rankings remain stable under alternative priorities for energy, throughput, memory, and power.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Although the evaluated formats can be ordered approximately by nominal precision, Q4_K_M, Q6_K, and Q8_0 are distinct block-wise representation schemes rather than points on a uniform continuous bit-width scale. For this reason, the revised analysis evaluates the full set of formats through within-model pairwise comparisons instead of assuming a linear relationship between nominal bit width and energy consumption. Future work should extend this analysis across additional quantization schemes, hardware architectures, and inference backends.</div></section></section></div><div id=\"Conclusions\" data-heading-anchor=\"1\"><section id=\"5Conclusions\" type=\"\"><h2 data-nested=\"1\">   5. Conclusions</h2><div class=\"html-p\">This study examined whether lower weight precision necessarily translates into lower GPU energy consumption during LLM inference. In the tested NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 and llama.cpp/CUDA environment, the strongest conclusion concerns autoregressive generation: Q4_K_M substantially outperformed BF16 within all four evaluated model families, reducing dynamic energy per token by 63.6–85.7% while simultaneously increasing generation throughput by 85.2–160.2%. These effects were statistically robust and demonstrate that aggressive weight quantization can provide major energy–performance benefits during generation.</div><div class=\"html-p\">However, the results do not justify treating nominal precision as a universal or architecture-independent predictor of energy use. The significant model × precision interactions show that the magnitude of the benefit depends on the model family, while the substantially weaker findings in the short prefill-only scenarios demonstrate that the effect is also workload-phase-dependent.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Among the evaluated generation configurations, Ministral 3 3B Instruct–Q4_K_M provided the most favorable combination of energy efficiency and throughput and ranked first in TOPSIS across all three scenarios. Nemotron 3 Nano 4B–Q4_K_M consistently ranked second and offered a substantially smaller GPU-memory footprint. Both configurations belonged to the Pareto frontier, illustrating that the preferred deployment option depends on the relative importance of energy, throughput, memory capacity, and power.</div><div class=\"html-p\">Overall, the results indicate that quantization formats should be evaluated empirically on the intended model–hardware–runtime combination. Deployment decisions should use request-level and token-level energy together with throughput, latency, power, and memory requirements rather than relying on nominal bit width alone. Because model quality was not measured, the identified hardware-efficiency rankings should not be interpreted as rankings of overall model quality or usability. The numerical effect sizes reported here should therefore be interpreted as specific to the tested RTX 4090–llama.cpp/CUDA environment and should be independently validated before being extrapolated to data-center accelerators, alternative GPU architectures, or production serving frameworks.</div></section></div><section><div id=\"Supplementary_Materials\" data-heading-anchor=\"1\"><section id=\"app1-energies-19-04893\" type=\"\"><h2 data-nested=\"1\">  Supplementary Materials</h2><div class=\"html-p\">The following supporting information can be downloaded at: <a href=\"https://www.mdpi.com/article/10.3390/en19204893/s1\" target=\"_blank\">https://www.mdpi.com/article/10.3390/en19204893/s1</a>, Table S1: Detailed pairwise results, including mean differences, confidence intervals, effect size, and Hold-adjusted <span class=\"html-italic\">p</span>-values.</div></section></div></section><div id=\"Author_Contributions\" data-heading-anchor=\"1\"><section class=\"html-notes\"><h2>Author Contributions</h2><div class=\"html-p\">Conceptualization, P.T., J.L., E.K., A.L. and R.P.; methodology, P.T. and J.L.; software, P.T., E.K. and R.P.; validation, P.T., J.L. and A.L.; formal analysis, J.L., P.T. and A.L.; investigation, P.T., J.L., E.K. and A.L.; resources, R.P.; data curation, E.K. and P.T.; writing—original draft preparation, J.L., P.T. and A.L.; writing—review and editing, J.L., E.K., A.L. and R.P.; visualization, P.T.; supervision, J.L. and P.T.; project administration, J.L. and R.P.; funding acquisition, P.T., J.L., E.K., A.L. and R.P. 一个**你能读懂、能复现、能扩展**的 Python Code Agent。它在你本地工作区读写文件、跑测试、 跑 lint、调 MCP 工具，并把每一步计划、工具调用和观察结果写成 **append-only 的会话日志**—— 出了问题可以回放、可以诊断、可以**从任意一步分叉重跑**。 它不是又一个聊天黑盒：内核只有 ReAct 主循环，可选能力都是挂在 生命周期钩子上的扩展；上下文折叠**不删原文**，所以 ablation 结论真的能被验证。 > 如果这个项目对你有用，点个 ⭐ 让更多人看到。 --- ## ⚡ 60 秒上手 ```bash git clone https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent.git && cd DM-Code-Agent uv sync --frozen --extra dev # 或 pip install -e ".[dev]" cp .env.example .env # 填入至少一个 API key ``` ```bash # 跑一个任务，同时留一份可审计的会话日志 dm-agent "修复 retry.py 的重试边界，并运行测试" --trace sessions/fix.jsonl --show-steps # 立刻诊断这次运行：哪一步失败、有没有重规划恢复、有没有跳过验证 dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/fix.jsonl ``` **先试不掏钱**：测试、确定性 eval 和 benchmark manifest 检查**完全不需要 API key**。 ```bash python -m pytest && python -m dm_agent.evals.cli --variant full --task direct_finish ``` 想在浏览器里看： ```bash dm-agent-web --read-only # 只读展厅：审计会话，不需要 API key dm-agent-web # 完整工作台：对话式交任务 + 实时看每一步 ``` 终端会打印一条带 token 的地址，点开即可。详见 [Web 控制台](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/web.md)。 --- ## ⭐ 七个别处没有的东西 ### 🌳 运行历史是一棵永不删除的树 别的 agent 压缩上下文 = 扇掉历史，事后没法追。这里每条日志带 `id` 和 `parent_id`， 折叠只**追加**一条「我压缩了」的派生记录，**原文一条不删**。所以你能： ```bash dm-agent-trace view sessions/fix.jsonl # 看时间线 dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/fix.jsonl # 诊断失败阶段 / 恢复情况 / 验证缺口 dm-agent-trace diff a.jsonl b.jsonl # 对比两次运行 dm-agent-trace fork sessions/fix.jsonl --at 4f4bdeee-0007 # 从第 7 条分叉重跑 dm-agent-trace replay sessions/fix.jsonl # 显式重放工具调用 dm-agent-trace analyze-dir sessions/ # 批量聚合统计 ``` ### 📉 上下文折叠带净收益护栏，压亏了就整体回滚 折叠是**本地确定性**的（Mem0 风格原子记忆），不额外烧一次 LLM 调用。更关键的是它会算账： `estimated_tokens_after < estimated_tokens_before` 才提交，**无收益的候选完整回滚** （memory、cadence、摘要状态全部还原）。已证明正收益的折叠会跨请求、跨 run 粘性复用， trace 里明写 `phase=sticky_reuse`，不把复用计成一次新压缩。 ### 🖥️ 浏览器里对话，浏览器里审计 ```bash dm-agent-web --read-only # 只读展厅：免 API key，能审计不能发起运行 dm-agent-web # 完整工作台：对话式交任务 + SSE 实时看每一步 ``` 主界面是一个**对话窗口**，而且是真多轮——同一段对话里第二轮记得第一轮做过什么、 读过哪些文件。实现方式是给 CLI 加了一个长驻模式（`--conversation-stdin`）：一个 子进程、一个 `ReactAgent`、顺序跑多轮，对话历史和本地记忆天然延续。切换视图、 甚至刷新浏览器都不会中断正在跑的轮次。 四个审计视图各回答一个问题：**会话库**（哪些跑成功了，以及**哪些跑成功了但过程 不健康**；支持删除，删除是移进 `sessions/.trash/` 而不是抹掉）、**运行详情** （对话 / 执行链 / 诊断 / 折叠四个分区）、**诊断**（失败在哪个阶段、有没有恢复、 有没有跳过验证）、**行为 diff**（两次运行从第几步开始分道扬镳）。 三条边界让它不会变成「第二个事实来源」： - **live run 与历史 trace 共用一套渲染器**——它们本来就是同一份 append-only JSONL。 对话界面只是这份条目流的另一种排版，所以历史会话也能以对话形式打开。 - **前端不算任何结论**。失败阶段、健康度、验证缺口全部由 `dm_agent.tracing` 算好送过来， 与 `dm-agent-trace analyze` 同源；`tests/test_server_readonly.py` 有一条断言逐字段比对 API 响应与直接调用纯函数的结果，防止 server 层自己算一遍导致漂移。 - **发起运行 spawn 一个 CLI 子进程**（`python -m dm_agent.cli`），而不是在服务进程里 另装一套 `ReactAgent`。所以 Web 永远和命令行做同一件事。 只读展厅用 hash 路由 + `base: './'`，把构建产物和会话 JSONL 一起丢到任何静态托管上就能跑， **不需要后端，也不需要 key**。详见 [Web 控制台](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/web.md)。 ### 🔌 加工具 / 守卫 / 模型供应商，一行内核代码都不用改 写一个导出 `setup(api)` 的 `.py` 丢进目录就行。四个注册方法 （`register_tool` / `register_skill` / `register_provider` / `on`）＋ **六个可拦截的生命周期钩子**： | 钩子 | 你能干什么 | | --- | --- | | `before_tool_call` | 改参数，或 `{block, reason}` 直接拦下危险操作 | | `after_tool_result` | 中间件式改写 observation | | `before_llm_request` | 发给模型前改写 messages | | `before_finish` | 否决「假装做完了」 | | `on_run_start` / `on_run_end` | 改 metadata / 追加 prompt / `{retry: True}` 重跑一轮 | [`examples/block_dangerous_shell.py`](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/examples/block_dangerous_shell.py) 是一个 25 行的 可运行例子：拦住 `rm -rf`。发现来源有五级优先级（builtin → entry_points → 用户目录 → 项目目录 → `--extension`），**项目本地扩展需要显式信任**才会加载。 ### 🛡️ 护栏默认开，行为默认关 这条分类原则写进了项目宪法，不是随口一说： | 默认**开**（基础设施护栏） | 默认**关**（行为 / 算法） | | --- | --- | | read-before-edit 守卫、观察截断、token 预算触发折叠 | Adaptive Replanning（错误信号映射到重规划策略） | | 原子写 + 自动备份、LLM 统一重试 | | | `--checkpoint` / `--resume` run 级断点续跑 | | 新用户拿到的是一个**安全的**默认配置；研究者按需 `--enable-xxx` 打开单个变量做 ablation。 v2.1 做了一次减法：把 6 个**毕业标准依赖已冻结评测**的默认关模块删掉了 （Reflexion / Critic / Self-Consistency / 熔断 / 记忆卫生 / LLM 压缩），CLI 开关 35 → 23。 要复活其中任何一个，写成外部扩展即可——这正是扩展系统存在的意义。 ### 🔬 没有 API key 也能跑完整验证 | | | | --- | --- | | 单元测试 | **554 passed，1 skipped**（默认不需要 API key） | | 确定性 eval | 14 个任务 × 4 个变体，scripted client 驱动，**零网络调用** | | 前端 | vitest 覆盖展示层纯函数；CI 重新构建并**逐字节比对**入库产物 | | CI 矩阵 | Ubuntu + Windows × Python 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12，**6 个组合** | | 质量门禁 | ruff（`E F I UP B SIM TID RUF`）+ black + mypy + `uv lock --check` + pre-commit | | 分层契约 | `clients → tools → tracing → core → extensions → cli`，由 ruff `TID251` 在 CI 强制 | 内核最小化体现在职责拆分：`agent.py` 只负责装配与 ReAct 主循环，折叠、解析、工具调用、持久化和完成判定均由同层协作者负责。 ### 🧪 不吹分数 **本项目不声明任何未实际运行过的评测分数提升。** 旧 SWE-bench Lite 的 Docker/Tier-2 verifier 与 跨模型跑分**冻结**，SWE-bench Lite 子系统已在 v2.1 移除（它跑不通：Tier-1 baseline 0.0% resolved 且受 host verifier 噪声污染，Tier-2 verifier 从未实现）。 独立的 `swebench_verified/` 子系统已用官方 SWE-bench 4.1.0 harness 完成真实跨仓库 运行：20 题 resolved 11/20（55%），50 题 resolved 21/50（42%），最终 error=0。 20 题是 50 题的严格前缀，不是独立复验；完整边界见 [devlog 42](docs/research-log/42-swebench-crossrepo-50.md)。 记分牌是自带的 **coding + maintenance benchmark**：**30 道题**（coding 15 + maintenance 15），隐藏测试判 pass/fail， 不依赖 Docker 与 HuggingFace；13 题只是历史 baseline。 13 题时代的存档 baseline 是 `pass_rate 0.385（5/13）`，而隐藏测试通过率 `0.769`—— 差距全在「改了不该改的文件」和「步数耗尽」上（`bench_reports/baseline-20260803.json`， 对应旧任务集，不可与 30 题分数直接比较）。 ```bash dm-agent-bench --suite all --provider deepseek --output bench_reports/after.json dm-agent-score-diff bench_reports/before.json bench_reports/after.json ``` 输出**逐题 pass/fail 翻转**而不只是总分——回归即使在总分上升时也单独列出。 30 题规模下一题翻转是 ±3.3 个百分点，这是分辨率而非实测噪声；repeat-3 的经验噪声底约为 ±5 题。完整口径见[项目现状](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/project-status.md)。 ### 📌 最近八轮做成了什么 从越界修改、编辑自伤和误报 replan 的过程护栏，到确定性 manifest、官方 harness 真实跨仓库运行与离线失败分析，关键结论和证据已整理在[最近八轮进展](docs/recent-progress.md)。 --- ## 👀 一次真实运行长什么样 下面是**真跑出来的输出**（确定性 eval 的 `tool_failure_replan` 任务，无需 API key）—— 读文件失败 → 触发重规划 → 换路径完成： ```console $ dm-agent-trace view sessions/demo.jsonl Trace run: 4f4bdeee197d415e8fc8992c227605f9 Task: If reading missing.txt fails, create recovered.txt instead. Status: success Provider: deepseek Model: deepseek-chat Events: 22 Steps: 3 1. read_file -> 文件 missing.txt 不存在。 2. create_file -> 已将 24 个字符写入 recovered.txt。 3. task_complete -> 任务完成：recovered Final: 任务完成：recovered ``` `analyze` 不只告诉你成功了，还会**指出它偷的懒**——这次它没跑任何验证就宣布完成： ```console $ dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/demo.jsonl Trace analysis Status: success Primary failure stage: tool Final failure stage: none Recovery: failures=1, replans=1, replanned_after_failure=true, recovered=true Verification: actions=0, before_finish=false, gap=true Hallucination signals: edit_without_read=0, guard_blocks=0, truncations=0, missing_paths=1 Health: warning (0.80) Issues: - verification_gap ``` 这就是「可审计」的意思：**任务成功 ≠ 过程健康**，而后者是能被机器读出来的。 --- ## 🏗️ 架构一眼看完 ```mermaid flowchart TD WEB["server — Web 控制台（与 cli 同级）
只读审计 API · SSE 实时流 · 子进程执行器"] CLI["cli — 最外层装配者

context_window · response_parser · tool_invoker · completion
replan · persistence · run_state · observation · prompting"] TRACING["tracing — 会话条目树 · append-only 写入 · 隐私分档 · fork"] TOOLS["tools — 17 个内置工具 + MCP 动态工具"] CLIENTS["clients — deepseek / openai / claude / gemini + 可注册自定义"] WEB -. "spawn 子进程，不把 CLI 当库用" .-> CLI CLI --> EXT EXT -. "六个可拦截的生命周期钩子" .-> CORE CORE --> TRACING --> TOOLS --> CLIENTS ``` 依赖**单向向下**（`clients → tools → tracing → core → extensions → cli`）， 由 ruff `TID251` 在 CI 强制——`core` 层想 import `cli` 会直接构建失败。 `server` 与 `cli` 同级：它 spawn CLI 子进程，所以 Web 界面永远和命令行做同一件事， 这条由 `tests/test_server_layering.py` 的 AST 断言守着。 文字版权威说明见 [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)。 --- ## # DM-Code-Agent
**本地优先 · 全程可审计 · 内核只有一个 ReAct 循环** [![CI](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-554%20passed%2C%201%20skipped-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/tree/main/tests) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/downloads/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/stargazers) [![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent?color=informational)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/commits/main) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-docs%2F-purple.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/tree/main/docs) [![Research Log](https://img.shields.io/badge/Research%20Log-43%20entries-orange.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/tree/main/docs/research-log) **中文** | [English](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/README_EN.md)
一个**你能读懂、能复现、能扩展**的 Python Code Agent。它在你本地工作区读写文件、跑测试、 跑 lint、调 MCP 工具，并把每一步计划、工具调用和观察结果写成 **append-only 的会话日志**—— 出了问题可以回放、可以诊断、可以**从任意一步分叉重跑**。 它不是又一个聊天黑盒：内核只有 ReAct 主循环，可选能力都是挂在 生命周期钩子上的扩展；上下文折叠**不删原文**，所以 ablation 结论真的能被验证。 > 如果这个项目对你有用，点个 ⭐ 让更多人看到。 --- ## ⚡ 60 秒上手 ```bash git clone https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent.git && cd DM-Code-Agent uv sync --frozen --extra dev # 或 pip install -e ".[dev]" cp .env.example .env # 填入至少一个 API key ``` ```bash # 跑一个任务，同时留一份可审计的会话日志 dm-agent "修复 retry.py 的重试边界，并运行测试" --trace sessions/fix.jsonl --show-steps # 立刻诊断这次运行：哪一步失败、有没有重规划恢复、有没有跳过验证 dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/fix.jsonl ``` **先试不掏钱**：测试、确定性 eval 和 benchmark manifest 检查**完全不需要 API key**。 ```bash python -m pytest && python -m dm_agent.evals.cli --variant full --task direct_finish ``` 想在浏览器里看： ```bash dm-agent-web --read-only # 只读展厅：审计会话，不需要 API key dm-agent-web # 完整工作台：对话式交任务 + 实时看每一步 ``` 终端会打印一条带 token 的地址，点开即可。详见 [Web 控制台](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/web.md)。 --- ## ⭐ 七个别处没有的东西 ### 🌳 运行历史是一棵永不删除的树 别的 agent 压缩上下文 = 扇掉历史，事后没法追。这里每条日志带 `id` 和 `parent_id`， 折叠只**追加**一条「我压缩了」的派生记录，**原文一条不删**。所以你能： ```bash dm-agent-trace view sessions/fix.jsonl # 看时间线 dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/fix.jsonl # 诊断失败阶段 / 恢复情况 / 验证缺口 dm-agent-trace diff a.jsonl b.jsonl # 对比两次运行 dm-agent-trace fork sessions/fix.jsonl --at 4f4bdeee-0007 # 从第 7 条分叉重跑 dm-agent-trace replay sessions/fix.jsonl # 显式重放工具调用 dm-agent-trace analyze-dir sessions/ # 批量聚合统计 ``` ### 📉 上下文折叠带净收益护栏，压亏了就整体回滚 折叠是**本地确定性**的（Mem0 风格原子记忆），不额外烧一次 LLM 调用。更关键的是它会算账： `estimated_tokens_after < estimated_tokens_before` 才提交，**无收益的候选完整回滚** （memory、cadence、摘要状态全部还原）。已证明正收益的折叠会跨请求、跨 run 粘性复用， trace 里明写 `phase=sticky_reuse`，不把复用计成一次新压缩。 ### 🖥️ 浏览器里对话，浏览器里审计 ```bash dm-agent-web --read-only # 只读展厅：免 API key，能审计不能发起运行 dm-agent-web # 完整工作台：对话式交任务 + SSE 实时看每一步 ``` 主界面是一个**对话窗口**，而且是真多轮——同一段对话里第二轮记得第一轮做过什么、 读过哪些文件。实现方式是给 CLI 加了一个长驻模式（`--conversation-stdin`）：一个 子进程、一个 `ReactAgent`、顺序跑多轮，对话历史和本地记忆天然延续。切换视图、 甚至刷新浏览器都不会中断正在跑的轮次。 四个审计视图各回答一个问题：**会话库**（哪些跑成功了，以及**哪些跑成功了但过程 不健康**；支持删除，删除是移进 `sessions/.trash/` 而不是抹掉）、**运行详情** （对话 / 执行链 / 诊断 / 折叠四个分区）、**诊断**（失败在哪个阶段、有没有恢复、 有没有跳过验证）、**行为 diff**（两次运行从第几步开始分道扬镳）。 三条边界让它不会变成「第二个事实来源」： - **live run 与历史 trace 共用一套渲染器**——它们本来就是同一份 append-only JSONL。 对话界面只是这份条目流的另一种排版，所以历史会话也能以对话形式打开。 - **前端不算任何结论**。失败阶段、健康度、验证缺口全部由 `dm_agent.tracing` 算好送过来， 与 `dm-agent-trace analyze` 同源；`tests/test_server_readonly.py` 有一条断言逐字段比对 API 响应与直接调用纯函数的结果，防止 server 层自己算一遍导致漂移。 - **发起运行 spawn 一个 CLI 子进程**（`python -m dm_agent.cli`），而不是在服务进程里 另装一套 `ReactAgent`。所以 Web 永远和命令行做同一件事。 只读展厅用 hash 路由 + `base: './'`，把构建产物和会话 JSONL 一起丢到任何静态托管上就能跑， **不需要后端，也不需要 key**。详见 [Web 控制台](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/web.md)。 ### 🔌 加工具 / 守卫 / 模型供应商，一行内核代码都不用改 写一个导出 `setup(api)` 的 `.py` 丢进目录就行。四个注册方法 （`register_tool` / `register_skill` / `register_provider` / `on`）＋ **六个可拦截的生命周期钩子**： | 钩子 | 你能干什么 | | --- | --- | | `before_tool_call` | 改参数，或 `{block, reason}` 直接拦下危险操作 | | `after_tool_result` | 中间件式改写 observation | | `before_llm_request` | 发给模型前改写 messages | | `before_finish` | 否决「假装做完了」 | | `on_run_start` / `on_run_end` | 改 metadata / 追加 prompt / `{retry: True}` 重跑一轮 | [`examples/block_dangerous_shell.py`](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/examples/block_dangerous_shell.py) 是一个 25 行的 可运行例子：拦住 `rm -rf`。发现来源有五级优先级（builtin → entry_points → 用户目录 → 项目目录 → `--extension`），**项目本地扩展需要显式信任**才会加载。 ### 🛡️ 护栏默认开，行为默认关 这条分类原则写进了项目宪法，不是随口一说： | 默认**开**（基础设施护栏） | 默认**关**（行为 / 算法） | | --- | --- | | read-before-edit 守卫、观察截断、token 预算触发折叠 | Adaptive Replanning（错误信号映射到重规划策略） | | 原子写 + 自动备份、LLM 统一重试 | | | `--checkpoint` / `--resume` run 级断点续跑 | | 新用户拿到的是一个**安全的**默认配置；研究者按需 `--enable-xxx` 打开单个变量做 ablation。 v2.1 做了一次减法：把 6 个**毕业标准依赖已冻结评测**的默认关模块删掉了 （Reflexion / Critic / Self-Consistency / 熔断 / 记忆卫生 / LLM 压缩），CLI 开关 35 → 23。 要复活其中任何一个，写成外部扩展即可——这正是扩展系统存在的意义。 ### 🔬 没有 API key 也能跑完整验证 | | | | --- | --- | | 单元测试 | **554 passed，1 skipped**（默认不需要 API key） | | 确定性 eval | 14 个任务 × 4 个变体，scripted client 驱动，**零网络调用** | | 前端 | vitest 覆盖展示层纯函数；CI 重新构建并**逐字节比对**入库产物 | | CI 矩阵 | Ubuntu + Windows × Python 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12，**6 个组合** | | 质量门禁 | ruff（`E F I UP B SIM TID RUF`）+ black + mypy + `uv lock --check` + pre-commit | | 分层契约 | `clients → tools → tracing → core → extensions → cli`，由 ruff `TID251` 在 CI 强制 | 内核最小化体现在职责拆分：`agent.py` 只负责装配与 ReAct 主循环，折叠、解析、工具调用、持久化和完成判定均由同层协作者负责。 ### 🧪 不吹分数 **本项目不声明任何未实际运行过的评测分数提升。** 旧 SWE-bench Lite 的 Docker/Tier-2 verifier 与 跨模型跑分**冻结**，SWE-bench Lite 子系统已在 v2.1 移除（它跑不通：Tier-1 baseline 0.0% resolved 且受 host verifier 噪声污染，Tier-2 verifier 从未实现）。 独立的 `swebench_verified/` 子系统已用官方 SWE-bench 4.1.0 harness 完成真实跨仓库 运行：20 题 resolved 11/20（55%），50 题 resolved 21/50（42%），最终 error=0。 20 题是 50 题的严格前缀，不是独立复验；完整边界见 [devlog 42](docs/research-log/42-swebench-crossrepo-50.md)。 记分牌是自带的 **coding + maintenance benchmark**：**30 道题**（coding 15 + maintenance 15），隐藏测试判 pass/fail， 不依赖 Docker 与 HuggingFace；13 题只是历史 baseline。 13 题时代的存档 baseline 是 `pass_rate 0.385（5/13）`，而隐藏测试通过率 `0.769`—— 差距全在「改了不该改的文件」和「步数耗尽」上（`bench_reports/baseline-20260803.json`， 对应旧任务集，不可与 30 题分数直接比较）。 ```bash dm-agent-bench --suite all --provider deepseek --output bench_reports/after.json dm-agent-score-diff bench_reports/before.json bench_reports/after.json ``` 输出**逐题 pass/fail 翻转**而不只是总分——回归即使在总分上升时也单独列出。 30 题规模下一题翻转是 ±3.3 个百分点，这是分辨率而非实测噪声；repeat-3 的经验噪声底约为 ±5 题。完整口径见[项目现状](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/project-status.md)。 ### 📌 最近八轮做成了什么 从越界修改、编辑自伤和误报 replan 的过程护栏，到确定性 manifest、官方 harness 真实跨仓库运行与离线失败分析，关键结论和证据已整理在[最近八轮进展](docs/recent-progress.md)。 --- ## 👀 一次真实运行长什么样 下面是**真跑出来的输出**（确定性 eval 的 `tool_failure_replan` 任务，无需 API key）—— 读文件失败 → 触发重规划 → 换路径完成： ```console $ dm-agent-trace view sessions/demo.jsonl Trace run: 4f4bdeee197d415e8fc8992c227605f9 Task: If reading missing.txt fails, create recovered.txt instead. Status: success Provider: deepseek Model: deepseek-chat Events: 22 Steps: 3 1. read_file -> 文件 missing.txt 不存在。 2. create_file -> 已将 24 个字符写入 recovered.txt。 3. task_complete -> 任务完成：recovered Final: 任务完成：recovered ``` `analyze` 不只告诉你成功了，还会**指出它偷的懒**——这次它没跑任何验证就宣布完成： ```console $ dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/demo.jsonl Trace analysis Status: success Primary failure stage: tool Final failure stage: none Recovery: failures=1, replans=1, replanned_after_failure=true, recovered=true Verification: actions=0, before_finish=false, gap=true Hallucination signals: edit_without_read=0, guard_blocks=0, truncations=0, missing_paths=1 Health: warning (0.80) Issues: - verification_gap ``` 这就是「可审计」的意思：**任务成功 ≠ 过程健康**，而后者是能被机器读出来的。 --- ## 🏗️ 架构一眼看完 ```mermaid flowchart TD WEB["server — Web 控制台（与 cli 同级）
只读审计 API · SSE 实时流 · 子进程执行器"] CLI["cli — 最外层装配者
dm-agent · -eval · -bench · -trace · -economics · -manifest-diff"] EXT["extensions — ExtensionAPI · 注册表 · 五级发现 · 项目信任模型"] CORE["core — agent.py 只做装配 + ReAct 主循环
context_window · response_parser · tool_invoker · completion
replan · persistence · run_state · observation · prompting"] TRACING["tracing — 会话条目树 · append-only 写入 · 隐私分档 · fork"] TOOLS["tools — 17 个内置工具 + MCP 动态工具"] CLIENTS["clients — deepseek / openai / claude / gemini + 可注册自定义"] WEB -. "spawn 子进程，不把 CLI 当库用" .-> CLI CLI --> EXT EXT -. "六个可拦截的生命周期钩子" .-> CORE CORE --> TRACING --> TOOLS --> CLIENTS ``` 依赖**单向向下**（`clients → tools → tracing → core → extensions → cli`）， 由 ruff `TID251` 在 CI 强制——`core` 层想 import `cli` 会直接构建失败。 `server` 与 `cli` 同级：它 spawn CLI 子进程，所以 Web 界面永远和命令行做同一件事， 这条由 `tests/test_server_layering.py` 的 AST 断言守着。 文字版权威说明见 [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)。 --- ## # mini-claude-code **一个能自己改代码的 Agent。** 给它一个真实开源仓库和一句「测试挂了」，它自己读代码、定位根因、 改源码、跑测试 —— 而**成败由一个独立进程里的 `pytest` 判定，不采信它自己的说法**。 用 **Claude Agent SDK** 从零搭出 Coding Agent 的五个核心层，每一层都要求**有能失败的反向对照**， 不接受「跑通了」当作结论。 **目录**：[30 秒看结果](#30-秒看结果) · [架构](#架构) · [五个必须层](#五个必须层) · [四条设计规矩](#四条设计规矩都是被实测逼出来的) · [实测发现](#实测发现) · [怎么跑](#怎么跑) · [评测 harness 与 P1 结果](#评测-harnessp0-与-p1-方向性结果) · [仓库结构](#仓库结构) · [文档索引](#文档索引) · [不能证明什么](#这个项目不能证明什么) · [许可](#许可) --- ## 30 秒看结果 在 **more-itertools** 上固定提交、注入一个**单行差一错误**（`windowed` 首窗填充数多补一个）， 然后让 agent 自己去修： | 指标 | 实测（12 次运行） | |---|---| | 自主修好 | **12 / 12** | | 判定方式 | 独立 `pytest` 进程的**退出码**（非 agent 自述） | | 平均耗时 | **97.3 s**（93.9 – 103.6） | | 回合数 | 11 – 14 turns | | input token | 10,044 – 17,445 | | 测试文件被改动 | **0 次**（改测试不算修好） | | 靶场 commit 前后 | `d21dd31` → `d21dd31`，工作区干净 | 靶场规模：源码 3 文件 / **7,277 行**（`more_itertools/more.py` 单文件 5,644 行）， 测试 **768 passed / 21,202 subtests**，MIT，零运行时依赖。 缺陷就一行 —— `more_itertools/more.py:1068`： ```python # 注入的缺陷 yield tuple(window) + ((fillvalue,) * (n - len(window) + 1)) # 正确写法 yield tuple(window) + ((fillvalue,) * (n - len(window))) ``` 我自己独立核过这一对数字（不引用 agent 的自述）： | 状态 | pytest 输出 | 退出码 | |---|---|---| | 缺陷存在 | `2 failed, 767 passed, 21201 subtests passed in 20.88s` | 1 | | 改掉那个 `+ 1` | `768 passed, 21202 subtests passed in 21.86s` | 0 | --- ## 架构 ```mermaid flowchart TB CA["coding_agent.py

`agent_stop=success` 而 `outcome=failed`，合并成一栏就永远看不见这种分歧。 ### 2. 靶场的「坏」必须是 HEAD 的不变量 复位用的是 `git checkout`（**从 HEAD 还原**），所以缺陷必须**提交进靶场 HEAD**，否则第一次复位就把缺陷 一起还原掉了。曾因此静默坏了三个提交：基线 pytest 变成 0、判定「成功」，但**什么都没验证，而且不报错**。 现在有守卫：基线退出码为 0 时**直接中止、不调模型**。 ### 3. 可用范围靠 `tools=[]`，不是 `allowed_tools` 这是**反向对照照出来的洞**。只设 `allowed_tools` 时，实测 46 次调用里有 `Bash 19 / Read 9 / Edit 2 / Write 2 / Grep 1`，**其中一次 Read 读到了沙箱之外的文件**。 查 SDK 源码确认语义：`allowed_tools` 是「免询问自动放行」，**不是可用范围白名单**； 禁用全部内置工具要写 `tools=[]`。现在是五重：`tools=[]` + `allowed_tools` + `disallowed_tools` + `permission_mode="dontAsk"` + `strict_mcp_config=True`。 ### 4. 拒绝必须说明理由 每个工具的每种拒绝都返回具体原因，而不是静默失败 —— agent 需要知道「为什么被拒」才能换路， **这本身就是失败自省的一部分**。 --- ## 实测发现 ### 📉 `repo_map` 的旧设计被量化推翻 第一版让 `repo_map` 默认输出全量符号表：**46,776 字符**，其中 **76% 来自测试文件** （`tests/test_more.py` 有 762 个符号，比源码还多），**超过 20,000 的读取上限，给都给不全**。 而 `search_code` 一次平均只要 **171 字符** —— **贵 274 倍**。 改成摘要后 **359 字符**，便宜 130 倍。 > 教训：**工具价值要按「每次调用成本」衡量，不能按「信息是否更全」衡量。** ### 🔍 上下文压力不随仓库大小线性增长 大靶场基线的 input token（**10,271**）反而**低于**小靶场（10,168–13,504）。 原因是 `more.py` 有 181,098 字符而单次读取上限 20,000 —— **「全读」这条路物理上不存在**，agent 只能先 `search_code` 定位、再按区间读。 ### 🧪 加了工具 ≠ 会被用 A/B 两臂各 6 次（同一靶场、同一缺陷、单变量：`repo_map` 默认详细度 `symbols` vs `summary`）， 采用率都是 **1/6**，**未观察到差异**。6 次/臂的样本量不足以区分「1 次」和「2 次」， 所以只能报「未观察到」，不能声称新设计更好、也不能声称两者一样好（[`AB-REPO-MAP.md`](AB-REPO-MAP.md)）。 更值得注意的是：**12/12 次运行都去读了 `README.md` —— 而靶场里根本不存在这个文件**（只有 `README.rst`）。 这更像是**工具没被想到**，而不是它不被需要。所以下一步是改**工具描述**，不是继续调默认详细度。 （这条目前是**假设**，还没验证。） ### 🎯 缺陷是「变异测试」挑出来的，不是拍脑袋写的 对每个候选改动「改一次 → 跑测试 → 记失败数 → 改回去」。选中「填充数多补一个」是因为它 **只挂 2 个测试**，而且是**输出错误**（多一个 `None`）而非「少抛一个异常」—— 前者有确定的正确行为可比对。顺带发现上游一个**真实覆盖缺口**：`step < 1 → step < 0` 这个改动挂 **0 个**测试。 --- ## 怎么跑 ```powershell # 0) 环境（conda 不在 PATH 上，必须用完整路径） **revert** 出「有缺陷的起点」，让 agent 去修， 再由 harness 用**独立启动的 pytest** 判定它对没对。 **解决什么**：把「agent 说自己修好了」与「它真的修好了」分开。判定只认 harness 自己 跑出来的 pytest 结果，**agent 的自述对判定零影响** —— 实测到一个反例：某次运行里 agent 自评「未成功」，而独立判定是 `resolved=True`（F2P 5/5、P2P 60/60）；若采信自述就会跟着判错。 **怎么用**：见 [`eval/README.md`](eval/README.md)（可照抄的三条命令）。判据先于数据写死在 [`eval/PREREGISTRATION.md`](eval/PREREGISTRATION.md)（预注册），**定义第一条实例之前 4 小时 12 分 **没有 Docker 镜像 / conda 环境**：环境类失败会落进我们的 `infra_error`，**不是 agent 能力问题**。 - **第三向（错补丁）在 3/12 条上无额外判别力**（详见 `eval/reports/p0-verification.md`）。 - **§4.2 的 F2P 准入是对冻结文本的「按目的细化」**：实现只排除「基线本来就红」的 node， 与公式的字面读法不同；**12 条里 10 条**在字面读法下不成立（见下方"偏离声明"）。 - **`usage.jsonl` 的成本字段**：t5 冒烟那次为 null，已在 t8 修复（`7e64816`）， 但**修后尚未重跑一次真实 agent 复核**。 - **并发隔离不变量曾经不成立**：t4 独立复核发现共享 venv 的 `.pth` 竞态可造成**静默误判** （实测 6 轮触发 6 次，其中 2 次判定用的是别人的工作区）。**已在 t8 修复**（提交 `7e64816`， venv 改为按「实例 + run」隔离）；修复后同场景 6 轮 **0 infra、0 静默误判**。 ### t9 独立审查的四项裁定（原样落纸，不美化） 1. **§4.2 的偏离性质 = 「细化」，不是「越权」；但必须声明为「偏离」。** 从归档的原始 pytest report 重算 12/12：F2P 里**没有任何**「基线本来就红」的 node， 字面读法下 F2P 为空 ⇒ 该实例被 E5 淘汰。**影响面：12 条里 10 条**在字面读法下不成立 （而 §7.1 禁止降低判据凑数）。判「细化」的依据：§4.2 自己的**目的句**只把排除范围限定为 「基线上本来就红的测试」；与官方 SWE-bench 的 F2P 语义一致；**规则文本未被偷改** （`git diff` 对 `PREREGISTRATION.md` 为空，差异写在抽样日志与各实例的 `known_limits` 里， 10/10 都在）；且「基线红就排除」这条路径仍然活着（另有实例因基线本就有病被淘汰）。 **若要守字面读法，正确路径是重新预注册**（回改 §1–§9 会毁掉冻结性），代价是 **10/12 条不可用** —— 审查者的结论是不建议。**不得写成「预注册本来就这么说」。** 2. **3 条 tabulate 实例「第 3 向无额外判别力」= 接受，不要求重做。** 这 3 条的 `wrong_patch` 与 `patch` **逐字节相同**、生成方法标为 `reverse_of_gold` ⇒ 链式施加净效果等于基线、与第 2 向同状态。**3/12 条少一向判别力。** harness 层「能干净 apply 但改错 ⇒ 判 unresolved」的判别力**由其余 9 条独立证成** （那 9 条第三向是 `unrelated_file_comment`，干净 apply + 结果 unresolved）。 3. **README.md 被丢弃那条 = 按规则丢弃、且已留痕，不是漏掉。** 按 §3.1 分类规则第 3 条「非 `.py` 一律丢弃并记入 `known_limits`」处理。 全量 23 条扫描：有非 `.py` 改动未被点名的实例数 = **0**。pilot-12 里**没有**任何修复提交 改到 `README.md`；README 系文件出现在 more-itertools 两条（`README.rst`，已点名）与 2 条 tabulate **reserve**（`README.md`，`known_limits` 原文已写明）。 ⚠ **方法论坑**：tabulate 的 `known_limits` 固定条目里含 `--doctest-glob=README.md` 这类文本， **只用 basename 子串匹配会「假通过」** —— 必须按显式的「丢弃…：<列表>」条目核对。 4. **t9 的两条 low finding**（结论对、说法错的那种，已在本轮修掉）： - **F1**：t8 说「不传 `trace` 时行为与改动前**逐字一致**」**字面不成立** —— 同进程对比，写盘行**新增 1 个键 `usage_source`**，删除键 0、既有键的值变化 0。 已在 `servers/experiments/usage_log.py` 改成准确表述，并保留 `usage_source` （让产物自描述是对的，不反向迁就一句不严谨的表述）。**这是对 t8 表述的更正。** - **F2**：t8 对 D7 的**结论成立、数字精确复现**（注入 CRLF ⇒ 251,255 B；归一化 ⇒ 1,268 B，198.2×）， 但**机理讲错了**：`git diff` **并没有**归一化行尾（字节模式 254,616 B / CRLF 3,361 处）， 是 harness 的 `env.sh()` 以 `text=True` 读子进程输出（universal newlines）折掉了 CRLF。 归档件 `t5-smoke/agent_candidate_patch.diff` 的 CRLF=0 正是这个**读法**造成的， 它是**损失性产物**，不能用来证明「采集时正文没有 CRLF」（独立证据：该归档件里 `pyproject.toml` 212/213 对 `-`/`+` 行逐字相同 —— 若正文真的没有 CRLF，git 不会产出这些 hunk）。 已在 `eval/harness/judge.py` 更正注释。附带一条给 P1 的提醒：受该读法所限， **harness 采集到的补丁文本天然不含 CRLF**，所以「补丁正文行尾」这条防线永不触发， 真正生效的只有工作树归一（`normalize_worktree_eol`）。 - 另有一处纯装饰性的陈旧帮助文本：`--timeout-probe` 的帮助原写「压到 1s」， 实际是 **0.2s**，已顺手改成与代码一致。 --- ## 仓库结构 ``` mini-claude-code/ ├─ coding_agent.py 主循环 · 独立判定 · 记账 · 唯一 argparse（13 个开关） ├─ agent/ │ ├─ config.py 端点加载 · 摘父进程环境 · 凭据脱敏 · UTF-8 输出 │ └─ trace.py TraceRecorder（每步结构化落盘） ├─ servers/ │ ├─ code_tools_server.py 独立进程 MCP server · 5 个面向代码的工具 │ └─ experiments/ trace_report.py 等实验脚本；out/ 是运行产物（证据留原始字节） ├─ fixtures/ 仓内靶场：mini_repo（2 文件）/ small_pkg（20 文件） ├─ eval/ 预注册 · 实例构造 · 容器无关 harness · 独立审查报告 └─ setup_target.py 等 靶场准备：大 / 4 缺陷 / 硬（setup_multi / setup_hard） ``` 仓外（不进仓库）：`E:\aicoding\targets\`（more-itertools 三档靶场）、 `E:\aicoding\eval-runs\`（评测工作区与证据）、`E:\aicoding\eval-venvs\`（每实例独立 venv）。 --- ## 文档索引 | 文件 | 内容 | |---|---| | [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) | **项目立项**：目标、架构、工具清单与权限边界、验收标准、实施分解 | | [`VERIFY-agent.md`](VERIFY-agent.md) | agent 闭环的**四组验收**原始输出 + 6 项沙箱对照 + 「本阶段不能证明的事」 | | [`TRACE.md`](TRACE.md) | **全链路 trace**：数据结构、检测项、反向对照、七个坑、不能证明的事 | | [`AB-REPO-MAP.md`](AB-REPO-MAP.md) | **A/B 实验报告**：`repo_map` 默认详细度对采用率的影响（含独立复核与勘误） | | [`VERIFY.md`](VERIFY.md) | 端点配置优先级的四格隔离实验 | | [`VERIFY-mcp.md`](VERIFY-mcp.md) | 独立进程 stdio + 跨两个客户端的完整原始输出 | | [`SDK-HELLO.md`](SDK-HELLO.md) | SDK 最小验证（端点优先级 / 密钥归因 / MCP 两形态对照） | | [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) | **60 条实测陷阱**（给接手这个仓库的 agent 看） | | [`AGENT.md`](AGENT.md) | 接手速查 | --- ## 这个项目**不能**证明什么 写在这里是为了让结论不被放大： - **不是 benchmark。** 缺陷全是**我自己注入**的，我当然知道它在哪 —— 真实 GitHub issue 的定位难度不可比，不能外推。规模也小：3 个注入式靶场（`mini_repo` / `small_pkg` / `more-itertools` 的三代）、每臂 4–12 次运行。 - **模型不可换结论。** 全部运行走同一个第三方端点，换模型后上面所有数字都要重测。 - **A/B 的样本量不够。** 每臂 4–6 次，区分不了「1 次」和「2 次」，只能报「未观察到差异」； ④ 层第二轮更暴露出这条规则的一个具体漏洞：**采用率为 0 时，两臂比较测的是噪声， 而噪声恰好能让"极差区间不重叠"成立**（见 [`AB-SUBAGENT-HARD.md`](AB-SUBAGENT-HARD.md) §7.3）。 - **`slow_step` 的阈值是拍的。** trace 里「相邻记录间隔 > 30 s」判为慢步骤，这个 30 s 没有依据。 - **subagent 那一层的收益没被证明。** 层是做完了（⑤ 个必须层都完成了），但两轮 A/B 里 「邀请使用」**都是 0/4 被采用**（第一轮靶场把函数名免费送出、第二轮把这条捷径堵掉了， 结论没变）；强制使用（阳性对照）时父层上下文 ×1.68、成本 ×1.92、成功率不变。 子代理本身是称职的（4/4 找对全部根因）—— 所以这既不是「subagent 没用」， 也不是「subagent 有用」（见 [`AB-SUBAGENT-HARD.md`](AB-SUBAGENT-HARD.md) §7）。 - **④ 层的实验里，子代理和父 agent 共用一个工作区。** 父 agent 的补丁会在子代理 侦察期间改掉它正在读的代码（C-2 因此去翻不存在的"备份产物"、烧光回合预算）。 只读侦察的前提在共享工作区下**不成立**，本轮的数据是在这条缺陷存在时取得的 （见 [`SUBAGENT.md`](SUBAGENT.md) §7.2）。 - **没有真实 GitHub issue 的闭环、没有 Docker 化、没有录屏。** --- ## 许可 本项目代码以 [MIT](LICENSE) 发布（Copyright © 2026 kingjone0）。 # DM-Code-Agent
**本地优先 · 全程可审计 · 内核只有一个 ReAct 循环** [![CI](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-554%20passed%2C%201%20skipped-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/tree/main/tests) [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/downloads/) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/LICENSE) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent?style=flat&color=yellow)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/stargazers) [![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent?color=informational)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/commits/main) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-docs%2F-purple.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/tree/main/docs) [![Research Log](https://img.shields.io/badge/Research%20Log-43%20entries-orange.svg)](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/tree/main/docs/research-log) **中文** | [English](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/README_EN.md)
一个**你能读懂、能复现、能扩展**的 Python Code Agent。它在你本地工作区读写文件、跑测试、 跑 lint、调 MCP 工具，并把每一步计划、工具调用和观察结果写成 **append-only 的会话日志**—— 出了问题可以回放、可以诊断、可以**从任意一步分叉重跑**。 它不是又一个聊天黑盒：内核只有 ReAct 主循环，可选能力都是挂在 生命周期钩子上的扩展；上下文折叠**不删原文**，所以 ablation 结论真的能被验证。 > 如果这个项目对你有用，点个 ⭐ 让更多人看到。 --- ## ⚡ 60 秒上手 ```bash git clone https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent.git && cd DM-Code-Agent uv sync --frozen --extra dev # 或 pip install -e ".[dev]" cp .env.example .env # 填入至少一个 API key ``` ```bash # 跑一个任务，同时留一份可审计的会话日志 dm-agent "修复 retry.py 的重试边界，并运行测试" --trace sessions/fix.jsonl --show-steps # 立刻诊断这次运行：哪一步失败、有没有重规划恢复、有没有跳过验证 dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/fix.jsonl ``` **先试不掏钱**：测试、确定性 eval 和 benchmark manifest 检查**完全不需要 API key**。 ```bash python -m pytest && python -m dm_agent.evals.cli --variant full --task direct_finish ``` 想在浏览器里看： ```bash dm-agent-web --read-only # 只读展厅：审计会话，不需要 API key dm-agent-web # 完整工作台：对话式交任务 + 实时看每一步 ``` 终端会打印一条带 token 的地址，点开即可。详见 [Web 控制台](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/web.md)。 --- ## ⭐ 七个别处没有的东西 ### 🌳 运行历史是一棵永不删除的树 别的 agent 压缩上下文 = 扇掉历史，事后没法追。这里每条日志带 `id` 和 `parent_id`， 折叠只**追加**一条「我压缩了」的派生记录，**原文一条不删**。所以你能： ```bash dm-agent-trace view sessions/fix.jsonl # 看时间线 dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/fix.jsonl # 诊断失败阶段 / 恢复情况 / 验证缺口 dm-agent-trace diff a.jsonl b.jsonl # 对比两次运行 dm-agent-trace fork sessions/fix.jsonl --at 4f4bdeee-0007 # 从第 7 条分叉重跑 dm-agent-trace replay sessions/fix.jsonl # 显式重放工具调用 dm-agent-trace analyze-dir sessions/ # 批量聚合统计 ``` ### 📉 上下文折叠带净收益护栏，压亏了就整体回滚 折叠是**本地确定性**的（Mem0 风格原子记忆），不额外烧一次 LLM 调用。更关键的是它会算账： `estimated_tokens_after < estimated_tokens_before` 才提交，**无收益的候选完整回滚** （memory、cadence、摘要状态全部还原）。已证明正收益的折叠会跨请求、跨 run 粘性复用， trace 里明写 `phase=sticky_reuse`，不把复用计成一次新压缩。 ### 🖥️ 浏览器里对话，浏览器里审计 ```bash dm-agent-web --read-only # 只读展厅：免 API key，能审计不能发起运行 dm-agent-web # 完整工作台：对话式交任务 + SSE 实时看每一步 ``` 主界面是一个**对话窗口**，而且是真多轮——同一段对话里第二轮记得第一轮做过什么、 读过哪些文件。实现方式是给 CLI 加了一个长驻模式（`--conversation-stdin`）：一个 子进程、一个 `ReactAgent`、顺序跑多轮，对话历史和本地记忆天然延续。切换视图、 甚至刷新浏览器都不会中断正在跑的轮次。 四个审计视图各回答一个问题：**会话库**（哪些跑成功了，以及**哪些跑成功了但过程 不健康**；支持删除，删除是移进 `sessions/.trash/` 而不是抹掉）、**运行详情** （对话 / 执行链 / 诊断 / 折叠四个分区）、**诊断**（失败在哪个阶段、有没有恢复、 有没有跳过验证）、**行为 diff**（两次运行从第几步开始分道扬镳）。 三条边界让它不会变成「第二个事实来源」： - **live run 与历史 trace 共用一套渲染器**——它们本来就是同一份 append-only JSONL。 对话界面只是这份条目流的另一种排版，所以历史会话也能以对话形式打开。 - **前端不算任何结论**。失败阶段、健康度、验证缺口全部由 `dm_agent.tracing` 算好送过来， 与 `dm-agent-trace analyze` 同源；`tests/test_server_readonly.py` 有一条断言逐字段比对 API 响应与直接调用纯函数的结果，防止 server 层自己算一遍导致漂移。 - **发起运行 spawn 一个 CLI 子进程**（`python -m dm_agent.cli`），而不是在服务进程里 另装一套 `ReactAgent`。所以 Web 永远和命令行做同一件事。 只读展厅用 hash 路由 + `base: './'`，把构建产物和会话 JSONL 一起丢到任何静态托管上就能跑， **不需要后端，也不需要 key**。详见 [Web 控制台](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/web.md)。 ### 🔌 加工具 / 守卫 / 模型供应商，一行内核代码都不用改 写一个导出 `setup(api)` 的 `.py` 丢进目录就行。四个注册方法 （`register_tool` / `register_skill` / `register_provider` / `on`）＋ **六个可拦截的生命周期钩子**： | 钩子 | 你能干什么 | | --- | --- | | `before_tool_call` | 改参数，或 `{block, reason}` 直接拦下危险操作 | | `after_tool_result` | 中间件式改写 observation | | `before_llm_request` | 发给模型前改写 messages | | `before_finish` | 否决「假装做完了」 | | `on_run_start` / `on_run_end` | 改 metadata / 追加 prompt / `{retry: True}` 重跑一轮 | [`examples/block_dangerous_shell.py`](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/examples/block_dangerous_shell.py) 是一个 25 行的 可运行例子：拦住 `rm -rf`。发现来源有五级优先级（builtin → entry_points → 用户目录 → 项目目录 → `--extension`），**项目本地扩展需要显式信任**才会加载。 ### 🛡️ 护栏默认开，行为默认关 这条分类原则写进了项目宪法，不是随口一说： | 默认**开**（基础设施护栏） | 默认**关**（行为 / 算法） | | --- | --- | | read-before-edit 守卫、观察截断、token 预算触发折叠 | Adaptive Replanning（错误信号映射到重规划策略） | | 原子写 + 自动备份、LLM 统一重试 | | | `--checkpoint` / `--resume` run 级断点续跑 | | 新用户拿到的是一个**安全的**默认配置；研究者按需 `--enable-xxx` 打开单个变量做 ablation。 v2.1 做了一次减法：把 6 个**毕业标准依赖已冻结评测**的默认关模块删掉了 （Reflexion / Critic / Self-Consistency / 熔断 / 记忆卫生 / LLM 压缩），CLI 开关 35 → 23。 要复活其中任何一个，写成外部扩展即可——这正是扩展系统存在的意义。 ### 🔬 没有 API key 也能跑完整验证 | | | | --- | --- | | 单元测试 | **554 passed，1 skipped**（默认不需要 API key） | | 确定性 eval | 14 个任务 × 4 个变体，scripted client 驱动，**零网络调用** | | 前端 | vitest 覆盖展示层纯函数；CI 重新构建并**逐字节比对**入库产物 | | CI 矩阵 | Ubuntu + Windows × Python 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12，**6 个组合** | | 质量门禁 | ruff（`E F I UP B SIM TID RUF`）+ black + mypy + `uv lock --check` + pre-commit | | 分层契约 | `clients → tools → tracing → core → extensions → cli`，由 ruff `TID251` 在 CI 强制 | 内核最小化体现在职责拆分：`agent.py` 只负责装配与 ReAct 主循环，折叠、解析、工具调用、持久化和完成判定均由同层协作者负责。 ### 🧪 不吹分数 **本项目不声明任何未实际运行过的评测分数提升。** 旧 SWE-bench Lite 的 Docker/Tier-2 verifier 与 跨模型跑分**冻结**，SWE-bench Lite 子系统已在 v2.1 移除（它跑不通：Tier-1 baseline 0.0% resolved 且受 host verifier 噪声污染，Tier-2 verifier 从未实现）。 独立的 `swebench_verified/` 子系统已用官方 SWE-bench 4.1.0 harness 完成真实跨仓库 运行：20 题 resolved 11/20（55%），50 题 resolved 21/50（42%），最终 error=0。 20 题是 50 题的严格前缀，不是独立复验；完整边界见 [devlog 42](docs/research-log/42-swebench-crossrepo-50.md)。 记分牌是自带的 **coding + maintenance benchmark**：**30 道题**（coding 15 + maintenance 15），隐藏测试判 pass/fail， 不依赖 Docker 与 HuggingFace；13 题只是历史 baseline。 13 题时代的存档 baseline 是 `pass_rate 0.385（5/13）`，而隐藏测试通过率 `0.769`—— 差距全在「改了不该改的文件」和「步数耗尽」上（`bench_reports/baseline-20260803.json`， 对应旧任务集，不可与 30 题分数直接比较）。 ```bash dm-agent-bench --suite all --provider deepseek --output bench_reports/after.json dm-agent-score-diff bench_reports/before.json bench_reports/after.json ``` 输出**逐题 pass/fail 翻转**而不只是总分——回归即使在总分上升时也单独列出。 30 题规模下一题翻转是 ±3.3 个百分点，这是分辨率而非实测噪声；repeat-3 的经验噪声底约为 ±5 题。完整口径见[项目现状](https://github.com/hwfengcs/DM-Code-Agent/blob/main/docs/project-status.md)。 ### 📌 最近八轮做成了什么 从越界修改、编辑自伤和误报 replan 的过程护栏，到确定性 manifest、官方 harness 真实跨仓库运行与离线失败分析，关键结论和证据已整理在[最近八轮进展](docs/recent-progress.md)。 --- ## 👀 一次真实运行长什么样 下面是**真跑出来的输出**（确定性 eval 的 `tool_failure_replan` 任务，无需 API key）—— 读文件失败 → 触发重规划 → 换路径完成： ```console $ dm-agent-trace view sessions/demo.jsonl Trace run: 4f4bdeee197d415e8fc8992c227605f9 Task: If reading missing.txt fails, create recovered.txt instead. Status: success Provider: deepseek Model: deepseek-chat Events: 22 Steps: 3 1. read_file -> 文件 missing.txt 不存在。 2. create_file -> 已将 24 个字符写入 recovered.txt。 3. task_complete -> 任务完成：recovered Final: 任务完成：recovered ``` `analyze` 不只告诉你成功了，还会**指出它偷的懒**——这次它没跑任何验证就宣布完成： ```console $ dm-agent-trace analyze sessions/demo.jsonl Trace analysis Status: success Primary failure stage: tool Final failure stage: none Recovery: failures=1, replans=1, replanned_after_failure=true, recovered=true Verification: actions=0, before_finish=false, gap=true Hallucination signals: edit_without_read=0, guard_blocks=0, truncations=0, missing_paths=1 Health: warning (0.80) Issues: - verification_gap ``` 这就是「可审计」的意思：**任务成功 ≠ 过程健康**，而后者是能被机器读出来的。 --- ## 🏗️ 架构一眼看完 ```mermaid flowchart TD WEB["server — Web 控制台（与 cli 同级）

# TROT: Triage of Observation Tokens for Efficient LLM Agents

📄 **Paper:** [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=OgkJ87Gu35&noteId=OgkJ87Gu35)

## Abstract

LLM coding agents accumulate large observation histories, including conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, and tool outputs, causing context windows to grow and inference costs to increase. We present TROT (Triage of Observation Tokens), a hierarchical framework that selectively compresses and removes stale observations using deterministic rules, a lightweight learned gate, and an auxiliary LLM only when needed. On SWE-bench Verified across two model families, TROT achieves the highest task success while substantially reducing context size. It attains a 50.6% resolve rate with 55% token savings on Sonnet-4.6 and a 46.1% resolve rate with 46% token savings on Devstral-24B, while requiring 6× fewer auxiliary LLM calls than uniform LLM-based reflection.

![TROT pipeline](figures/pipeline.png)

*Figure: TROT pipeline. Each observation passes through three layers in cost order: a deterministic compressor (zero cost), a learned gate (near-zero cost), and an auxiliary LLM used selectively. The agent sees the result, and the history compressor feeds back into the next step.*

## Method

TROT handles observations in three layers, cheapest first:

1. **Deterministic rules (zero cost).** Veto compression for critical content such as error traces and first-time outputs, and apply pattern-based compression to known waste: stale file re-reads, submit boilerplate, and edit confirmations.
2. **Learned gate (near-zero cost).** Predicts downstream utility from trajectory-state features and chooses SKIP, SUMMARY, or FULL for each observation.
3. **Auxiliary LLM (selective).** Summarizes only the observations the gate marks for summary.

## Baselines and Main Results

We compare against four baselines and the unmodified agent on SWE-bench Verified (89 held-out tasks), using the same agent loop, prompt, tools, and harness for every method.

| Baseline | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Baseline | Unmodified agent, full observations |
| TACO (Ren et al. 2026) | Self-evolved compression rules with critical-observation bypass |
| AgentDiet (Xiao et al. 2025) | Auxiliary Haiku reflection on observations above a token threshold |
| Truncation | Keeps the start and the error tail of each observation |
| Sliding Window (Lindenbauer et al. 2025) | Masks observations older than M steps with a placeholder |

Resolve rate is the percentage of tasks with a patch that passes the repository's tests. Token savings are relative to the baseline.

| Method | Sonnet-4.6 Resolve % | Tokens | Savings | Devstral-24B Resolve % | Tokens | Savings |
|--------|---------------------:|-------:|--------:|-----------------------:|-------:|--------:|
| Baseline | 45.9 | 647K | | 44.9 | 652K | |
| TACO | 47.1 | 713K | −10% | 43.8 | 592K | +9% |
| AgentDiet | 42.4 | 455K | +30% | 44.9 | 570K | +13% |
| Truncation | 38.8 | 527K | +19% | 41.6 | 580K | +11% |
| Sliding Window | 37.6 | 478K | +26% | 38.2 | 403K | +38% |
| **TROT (ours)** | **50.6** | **289K** | **+55%** | **46.1** | **349K** | **+46%** |

TROT is the only method that achieves both the highest resolve rate and the largest token savings on both models.

# Coding Harness

基于 DeepSeek 模型独立实现的最小 Coding Agent，可自主阅读代码、应用补丁并运行测试。

## 环境与配置

依赖 Git、Python 3.11+ 和 Docker（Windows 需开启 WSL2 集成）。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/piaoyun2022/coding-harness.git
cd coding-harness
cp .env.example .env
```
在 `.env` 文件中填写：`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=你的密钥`

## 运行评测 (SWE-bench Lite)

脚本会自动构建容器环境、执行 Agent 修复、运行官方测试并生成报告。结果写入 `artifacts/` 目录。

**Linux / WSL**
```sh
bash scripts/evaluate.sh
```

**Windows PowerShell**
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/evaluate.ps1
```

**常用参数：**
```sh
# 环境预检（不发模型请求）
bash scripts/evaluate.sh --preflight

# 指定跑 Agent前 30 题，2 路并发
bash scripts/evaluate.sh --mode agent --limit 30 --workers 2

# 全量 300 题，同时跑裸模型和 Agent
bash scripts/evaluate.sh --mode both --limit 300 --workers 2
```

## 修复本地仓库

```sh
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate  # Windows: .venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -e .

python -m coding_harness run \
  --repo /path/to/your/repo \
  --task "修复问题并运行测试" \
  --output artifacts/my-task
```
目标仓库代码保持不变，补丁和运行轨迹保存在 `--output` 目录。
